task.title: Phase N N6.4: the assertVisual step, runtime visual assertions through the fourth src/visual edge, the enforcement gate and experimental grants
task.objective: Implement awkit-vra.15.4: a non-retryable assertVisual step (schema, StepRequirements, validator mode check, fragment refusal, random Test Lab exclusion, Designer catalog entry defaulting to observe), the VA-15 stillness capture option, the lazily loaded VisualAssertionStep adapter as the fourth approved src/visual edge (handoff, protected-surface and sensitive refusals before resolution, exact-one visible target, read-only hover and focus, guarded element capture with no context crop, conditions, epoch token, baseline lookup and keyed commitment, the N6.2 policy, the grant read only when asked, memory-only candidates, one 2000 ms deadline), the flag x step mode x build gate in a contract module that never loads src/visual, separate visual-mismatch and visual-unverified classes with onFailure unchanged, packaged enforce steps always failing enforce-unavailable-in-production without reading grants, dev-only signed 30-day grants in VisualBaselineStore, runner and engine wiring with main-process services backed by the safeStorage protector, a mock-site Visual Assertion Lab, and verify:visual-assertion-runtime, verify:visual-assertion-grants, verify:visual-key-protector-live and the updated verify:visual-isolation.

acceptance.description: The flag x step mode x build matrix through the real executor, baselines, refusals with zero captures, interaction state, VA-15, deadline, cancellation, neutrality, memory-only candidates and enablement pass in real Chromium; the five runtime mutations are observed red.

The 240-cell outcome matrix matches the plan, the packaged build never reads or issues a grant, every bound field, expiry, tampering, keystore loss and reset invalidate, and eight gate mutants are caught.
The production safeStorage protector is exercised in the real Electron main process, or the live part is reported BLOCKED.
awkit-vra.15.4 closed, verifiers classified, dashboard pins updated and Sources agree, pushed to main.
